title: Darkfall smp
description: A minecraft SMP but with a small twist! Every death leaves a scar on the map-it spreads more Darkness!
body:
Darkfall SMP is a survival server where the world slowly falls into darkness.

Every player death has consequences. When someone dies, darkness begins to spread through the world, corrupting the land with sculk. Small mistakes may only leave small scars, but large battles can cause massive outbreaks that permanently change the environment.

As the corruption grows, the world becomes more dangerous. If too much darkness spreads in one area, it may even awaken something far worse.

Darkfall is not just about surviving — it's about shaping the world through your actions. Every fight, every risk, and every death leaves a mark on the server’s history.

Build alliances, explore the world, and try to keep the darkness under control… or watch the world slowly fall.
